rationale: The workflow already cancels superseded in-progress runs via concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), so no change is needed there. fail-fast is correctly left false because every matrix cell (OS x R version) is a required R CMD check outcome, so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated ('Every matrix outcome is required'). The remaining candidates lack verified prerequisites: ci_history reports 'not_a_measured_baseline' with no job durations, so P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT cannot set a safe timeout and risk killing valid slow Windows/macOS R CMD check runs. Path-based skipping/filtering (P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW, P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER) is contraindicated because DESCRIPTION/shared configuration affects all checks and required-check status is unverified. Dependency/environment caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, P-LIT-ENV-CACHE) is unsafe without a verified lockfile-only the Makefile is provided, it reads DESCRIPTION but no renv.lock or pinned transitive versions exist, which is mutable dependency resolution, a listed contraindication. No supported optimization has all preconditions met, so the workflow is unchanged.
